story.title: Our Story
paragraphs: Saffron & Hearth began as a small kitchen focused on simple truths: good oil, quality dough, and time spent on the dough.
It is now a restaurant built around fresh colours and textures, with menus updated for each season and dishes that invite sharing.
Meals are meant to be shared — have them served to you on foot.
